author: Goodnighht
body:
So we had a discussion in a walls today about strength in maps and I was curious what you guys thought?
We had some good points here are some of them:
- Strength for new players can be very annoying and make them quit. But on the other side to this new players can learn these things if they are patient.
- Makes the fights faster. But its not about the PvP its more for whoever gets the first hit... that's not to fun if we are gonna be honest lol
Those were the 2 main points that we talked about. There are of course many more but these are the 2 that made the most sense.
So, saying that should strength be removed from all maps? or only strength 2? because I agree to everything that was said lol but to come to a complete decision about anything we need most people to agree with us.

title: Strength In Walls Maps?

replies.author: Murphh
replies.body:
I don't know how to avoid strength 2 on any map that has strength on it already.  Glowstone is everywhere.  Same with redstone for the 8 minute potion.

You would have to get rid of all strength potions and any ingredients that you can use to create it (blaze spawn egg/ blaze rod/ blaze powder).

I am willing to remove strength and all ingredients on my map, as well as, the gapple.

It's true that one hit or two hit kills are no fun.
